identity.philosophy: Fusion over Imitation. Organic & Earthy Archetype. Mobile-first, tactile, and trustworthy.

headings.usage: Use for all section titles, card headers, and score displays.

body.usage: Use for instructions, descriptions, and form labels.

layout.container: max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-green-50/50 shadow-2xl overflow-hidden relative

Card.style: bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-green-100 overflow-hidden transition-all duration-200 hover:shadow-md hover:border-green-200
Card.usage: Used for all modules, metrics, and game containers.

Button.primary: bg-green-700 hover:bg-green-800 text-white rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-bold shadow-lg shadow-green-700/20 transition-transform active:scale-95
Button.secondary: bg-amber-100 hover:bg-amber-200 text-amber-900 rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-bold transition-transform active:scale-95
Button.outline: border-2 border-green-700 text-green-700 hover:bg-green-50 rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-bold

Input.style: bg-white border-2 border-green-100 focus:border-green-500 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-lg w-full outline-none transition-colors

Progress.indicator: h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-green-500 to-green-600 transition-all duration-500 ease-out

visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle noise or grain on the main background if possible.

hero_background.usage: Use as the background for the Welcome/Profile setup screen with an overlay.

gamification_coins.usage: Use for the 'Total Score' or 'Wealth' metric card icon.

icons.style: Stroke width 2px, rounded caps. Use Green-700 for primary icons, Amber-600 for rewards.

gamification.score_display: Large, bold numbers (text-4xl) with the coin icon next to it.
gamification.feedback: Use 'Sonner' toasts for instant feedback on answers.
gamification.animations: Animate score changes. Use 'framer-motion' for card entrances.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text is #1a2e05 on light backgrounds. Use #ffffff text on Green-700 buttons.
accessibility.touch_targets: All interactive elements must be at least 44px height.
accessibility.labels: All inputs must have visible labels.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'Profile Setup' as a step-by-step wizard.
The Dashboard should look like a 'Mission Control' for the farm.
Use the 'Lush Green Field' image as a subtle background pattern or header image.
The 'Loan Decision Game' should feel like a card game (Swipe or Select).
The 'Budget Challenge' must use a slider component.
Use 'localStorage' to persist the user profile and scores.
Ensure the app is fully responsive and looks native on mobile.
Use 'lucide-react' for all icons (Sprout, Tractor, Coins, Shield, TrendingUp).
Do NOT use default shadcn styles. Override them with the 'rounded-2xl' and 'border-green-100' styles defined here.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯📚🎭🎬🎪🎉🎊🎁🎀🎂🍰🎈🎨🎰💰💵💳🏦💎🪙💸🤑📊📈📉💹🔢🏆🥇 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
